caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden cabinet set against a plain, light beige background. The cabinet is rectangular and features two main sections, each with its own set of doors. The upper section has two doors with arched panels at the top, one of which is open to reveal two internal shelves. The lower section consists of square panels, with two doors that are closed. The cabinet has visible wood grain texture and is composed of shades of brown, light tan, and reddish hues, indicating natural wood coloring. Metal hinges and handles are attached to all doors, with three hinges on the upper doors and two on the lower, all depicted in a dull metallic gray color. The cabinet stands on short, outward-curving legs as part of its frame, and the edges and borders are highlighted with slightly darker wood tones for depth. The overall composition centers the cabinet on the page without additional objects present.
title: Corner Cupboard
